title: DOW-UAP-PR35, Unresolved UAP Report, Greece, October 2023
doc_notes: This document is a declassified USCENTCOM mission report (MISREP 9337873) detailing an ISR mission and a specific UAP sighting, heavily redacted under 1.4(a) and other authorities.

incidents.summary: An unidentified aerial phenomenon was observed flying just above the ocean surface towards land before being lost from the sensor feed.
behavior: flying straight above the ocean towards land
incidents.quote: SPOTTED A UAP FLYING JUST ABOVE THE SURFACE OF THE OCEAN WATER. THE UAP FLEW STRAIGHT ABOVE THE OCEAN TOWARDS LANDS.
